title: Aberration Hunters' Amulet
summary: A githyanki wearer gains advantage on Intelligence saves. The passive also lists disadvantage on aberrations’ attack rolls against the wearer, with a reported bug. Ancient Grudges is a Bonus Action once per Short Rest that grants advantage on attacks against aberrations.

fields.Effect: A Githyanki wearer, including a character disguised as Githyanki, gains Advantage on Intelligence saves. The passive lists Disadvantage on aberrations’ attacks against the wearer, with a reported bug.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Ancient Grudges: Bonus Action on yourself, once per Short Rest. Gain Advantage on attacks against Aberrations for 3 turns.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
